prompt: New fantasy woodland card art asset sheet, six independent square tiles, exact 1536×1024, hard 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows at 512 pixels, thin black separators. Use reference for crisp pixel texture, values and atmosphere only. Think through each scene before drawing. Final cards crop away the top and bottom 15% of every tile: all named props and their important parts must stay completely inside the middle 60% vertically, 80% horizontally. Deliberate pixel clusters, no text or borders except separators. One main action per picture. Top left. One tiny cloaked archer waits motionless on a broad crescent lookout ledge; the entire figure, compact bow and tiny stone water clock with one last glinting falling drop all fit across the middle horizontal band. View from several paces away, profile silhouette, pale jade sunrise. Top middle. Sideways over a wide flooded fen: exactly three complete separated short arrows travel toward the right like a branching sideways fan (one up-right, one right, one down-right). All arrowheads and fletching remain entirely visible with spare plain water all around the group. No strings and no arrows going up the frame. Top right. From under a big half-ruined arch, a cluster of blunt rounded cyan drops with amber rims rains over a broad puddle; center the drops and the orange steam rings together. Cyan sea-green and rounded silhouettes. Bottom left. A simple one-piece wooden bow lies diagonally almost horizontal across a flat stone workbench, entire bow centered and small in the frame. The single cord joins exactly its two tips as a straight line, and in the background a small magical tracing of the release shows only a single fading crescent, well separated from the physical bow. No human hands. One simple complete arrow lies next to the bow, not intersecting it. Slanting morning light. Bottom middle. One thick bronze-rimmed magnifying lens upright in a stone holder occupies half the tile; through it only a single tiny amber rune carved on the face of a far standing slab is magnified. A few dark mossy forest columns sit behind it. Keep both outer ring and rune fully in frame. No eyes. Bottom right. Exactly three tiny clockwork scarabs with one pair of thin copper wings each hover in a horizontal row at center over an empty paved court. Beneath each, a small round magic pearl and one cyan ripple. Keep whole scarabs carefully centered with clear air above so wings don't get trimmed. Clear sunny sage and bronze.

Reference for rendering only. Generate ONE 1536×1024 landscape image, exact grid with 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, narrow black dividers at exact thirds and half. Six independent square pictures. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters with hard pixel edges, controlled local colors, very legible silhouette and consistent light. Give each panel one distinct main object in the middle, physically plausible support, continuous outlines of props, sensible perspective and room around the important shape, simple backdrop. No text, numbers, UI, watermarks or decorative mid-panel borders. No modern hardware. Interpret subjects in exact reading order.
Top left. Elevated diagonal view of a straight, tall, continuous orange curtain of flames standing across an empty stone road at right angles. It spans one boulder bank to the other, path visible at both sides, pale emerald daylight behind.
Top middle. Close side-on view of three parallel iron bars supported on the sill of a brick furnace; each passes from dark plum at outer ends to white-hot orange at the same middle section. One deep black cavity makes the hottest metal read clearly. No hands.
Top right. One heart-shaped polished carnelian held in a bowl-shaped nest of dark ember feathers, one long golden feather curves behind. Slightly top-down still life, light comes from inside the actual stone, no anatomical heart, simple clear shape.
Bottom left. One solid jagged black rock edged orange streaks diagonally from a cobalt sky over an empty mountain basin, big incandescent tail points back away from the earth. Wide composition with clean skies on each side of the streak.
Bottom middle. One copper ingot firmly resting on a flat stone slab half covered in icy blue rime. Warm orange on one end, blue frost on the other; a fine white steam wisp rises at the boundary. Tight quiet scene, dark aubergine backdrop.
Bottom right. Side profile of one extremely long straight bronze spear with a full triangular point attached to the front of its only shaft. A narrow flame wraps the head and trails a short distance backward along it, otherwise plain dark shaft above an aubergine archway. Entire outline visible.
